title: Independent golden cases for the rotation calculator (phase 1)
sourceDocument: sources/original/rotation_sources.pdf (34 pp., supplied edition; text cross-checked with sources/extracted/rotation_sources.layout.txt and visually against rendered pages 13-17, 23-29, 31, 33)
sourceEditionNote: Values are from the SUPPLIED edition of order No 01-82 and its 10 annexes. Not checked against the full current consolidated text on matsne (not publicly accessible).

conventions.money: All money values are decimal strings. 'exact' is the unrounded rational value (a decimal, or 'a/b' when it does not terminate). 'display' is 'exact' rounded once, at the end, to 2 decimals.
conventions.roundingPolicy: PROPOSED technical policy (not a legal rule): no rounding of intermediate values; display rounding ROUND_HALF_UP to 2 decimals. Case T-ROUND-01 pins the half-way behaviour.
conventions.percentages: A_percent, E_percent are given in percent (65 means 65%). They are divided by 100 exactly once.
conventions.nullMeansUnknown: null in inputs means 'unknown / not entered'; it is never the same as 0. 'undetermined' in expected means the calculator must show an explicit undetermined state, not a number.

status.direct-rule: Follows directly from the cited text or table cell.
status.interpretation: Needs a reading of the text that the text does not state explicitly (e.g. G = T, per-child limit). Must be confirmed by the legal analyst / ministry.
status.technical-policy: Implementation policy (day proration, rounding, date counting); not a legal norm.

conventions.dayCounting: Calendar dates, both ends inclusive, no time zone / DST (date-only arithmetic). A change takes effect FROM its change date (Annex 1 art. 4 para 5), so the change day belongs to the new segment.
conventions.proration: PROPOSED technical policy: segmentAmount = fullMonthRate(segment inputs) x segmentDays / calendarDaysOfThatMonth; month total = exact sum of segments, rounded once.

ruleRefs: task sec. 4 'no repeated rounding of intermediates'
cases.description: Vienna S computed from rounded intermediates differs from the correct value; calculator must show 4985.16 from exact chain.
cases.derivation: rounded chain: D 4732.03, T = 4732.03 x 0.21 = 993.7263 -> 993.73, F = 993.73 + 0.5 x 506.27 = 1246.865 -> 1246.87, S = 4732.03 - 993.73 + 1246.87 = 4985.17 (!= 4985.16). Expected value recorded is the exact chain; the rounded-chain value 4985.17 is the anti-pattern.
